description:
Watch Berlin's buses, trams, and trains move live on the map — every second.

Berlin Transit Map shows you exactly where your next U-Bahn, S-Bahn, tram, or bus is right now. Not just timetables — real vehicles, moving in real time, on a real interactive map. Live BVG data, every second.

LIVE VEHICLE TRACKING
• Watch every U-Bahn, S-Bahn, tram, and bus move in real time on the map
• Color-coded BVG-authentic line colors
• Tap any vehicle for route, direction, and delay

LIVE DEPARTURES
• Tap any stop for live departure boards
• Delay alerts — never get caught off guard
• Arrival countdowns updated continuously
• Home-screen widget for your favorite stops

MODERN DESIGN
• Clean, native iOS map interface
• Smooth animations, intuitive gestures
• Dark mode, all iPhones, iPad supported
• Liquid Glass icon (iOS 26)

PRIVACY FOCUSED
• No account required
• No personal data collected
• No tracking, no ads

PERFECT FOR
• Daily Berlin commuters
• Tourists exploring the city
• Transit enthusiasts and rail fans
• Anyone who rides BVG

BONUS: Multi-city support
Tap Settings → Change City to explore live departures in München, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Köln, Leipzig, and Nürnberg too. Berlin is the only city with the full live vehicle map for now — more cities coming as operators publish vehicle GPS data.

Download Berlin Transit Map — faster decisions, fewer surprises, better timing. Every day.
promotionalText: Watch Berlin's buses, trams & trains move live on the map. Real-time BVG tracking — no account, no ads. The fastest way to catch your next ride.
whatsNew:
v1.8 — Faster, cleaner, better.

NEW: Fresh Berlin-themed app icon — the Fernsehturm with live transit lines and a glowing 'live tracking' indicator. Designed for iOS 26 Liquid Glass.

IMPROVED:
• Streamlined onboarding from 10 screens to 5 — get to the map faster
• Tighter onboarding copy, no questionnaire
• 22 new tests for stability across cities

BONUS: Tap Settings → Change City to try live departures in München, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Köln, Leipzig, or Nürnberg. Berlin keeps the full live vehicle map.

Berlin riders: nothing changes — same favorites, same widget, same live BVG tracking you rely on.
